name: Autolus Therapeutics plc
summary: Autolus Therapeutics plc, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, develops T cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases in the United Kingdom and internationally. The company offers AUCATZYL, a gene therapy product consisting of autologous T cells that are transduced with a lentiviral vector to express a novel anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor.
